title: Tarawa rescue
description:
A Coast Guard aircrew aboard an HC-130 Hercules airplane from Air Station Barbers Point spots a 17-foot skiff with three mariners, who had been missing for five days, approximately 80 miles off of the island of Tarawa, Wednesday, Oct. 17, 2012. 

The three men, ages 30, 20 and 20, departed Tarawa Oct. 12 in a 17-foot boat on a fishing trip when they encountered engine trouble about five miles from shore. The vessel was not equipped with oars or paddles and the men attempted to break off portions of the boat to paddle back to shore. The aircrew searched for approximately two days, covering an area approximately 2,800 square miles.
